title: Dutch Semolina Casserole
description: A classic Dutch dessert featuring semolina, gooey and quintessentially delicious. Serve warm.
instructions: 2. In a saucepan, combine semolina, milk, and sugar. Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until mixture thickens.
3. Remove from heat and stir in butter and vanilla extract.
4. In a separate bowl, whisk eggs.
5. Add egg mixture to semolina mixture and stir until combined.
6. Pour mixture into a greased 9x13-inch casserole dish.
7. Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until golden brown.
8. Serve warm, topped with additional sugar if desired.
